caption: The drawing features a single circular motif centrally positioned on a plain, beige background. Within the brown circular design, a detailed depiction of a cow standing on grass is shown in profile facing to the right, with its body taking up most of the space within the circle. Directly beneath the cow, a small calf is shown suckling. Above the cow, there is a detailed illustration of a woven beehive, also known as a skep, with small branches and leaves extending around it. The border of the circular motif includes additional details of foliage and flowers, completing the composition within the brown-toned circle. The rest of the background is unadorned and off-white, allowing the central circular drawing to stand out distinctly.
title: Butter Mold
